data.name: Fikriyah
data.gender_notes: Fikriyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'fikr' meaning 'thought' or 'memory'. In Islamic tradition, the name Fikriyah represents the importance of remembering and reflecting upon Allah's teachings and blessings. The name Fikriyah carries the meaning “Memory, Thought” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fikriyah usually hope their child will grow to embody memory, thought and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Encouragement to ponder and reflect on Islamic teachings and Allah's blessings.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fikriyah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
